name: ally
description: An experimental open-source accessibility audit orchestrator

scripts.test:e2e: pnpm build && pnpm run e2e:prepare && pnpm --filter @ally/report test:e2e
scripts.typecheck: turbo run build typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm test:e2e
scripts.pages:create: pnpm --dir apps/worker exec wrangler pages project create ally-audit-web --production-branch main
scripts.deploy:web: PUBLIC_SITE_URL=https://ally.andersseen.dev PUBLIC_ALLY_API_BASE=https://ally.andersseen.dev PUBLIC_UMAMI_URL=https://umami.andersseen.dev/script.js PUBLIC_UMAMI_WEBSITE_ID=ade5376e-baba-4f88-b4b7-dab4ef7d97b3 pnpm run build:web:production && pnpm --dir apps/worker exec wrangler pages deploy ../web/dist --project-name ally-audit-web --branch main --commit-dirty=true
scripts.deploy:web:analog: PUBLIC_SITE_URL=https://ally.andersseen.dev PUBLIC_ALLY_API_BASE=https://ally.andersseen.dev PUBLIC_UMAMI_URL=https://umami.andersseen.dev/script.js PUBLIC_UMAMI_WEBSITE_ID=ade5376e-baba-4f88-b4b7-dab4ef7d97b3 pnpm --filter @ally/web-analog build && pnpm --dir apps/worker exec wrangler pages deploy ../web-analog/dist/client --project-name ally-audit-web-analog --branch main --commit-dirty=true
